Here in Seattle, we know climate change is real and see its effects every single day. And together, we are fighting back against Trump’s actions to protect our planet and people.

Take a look at some of the incredible work happening in WA-07!

Video
It was great to meet with Seattle City Councilmember Eddie Lin and discuss his priorities, as well as how I can support his work and that of the Council at the federal level.

Thank you to all of the House Members who joined my accountability hearing on Trump’s attacks on TPS.

This program is critical to protect lives. We will not stop fighting for it.

Video

When @Rep_Jackson and I were in Cuba, we saw firsthand the shocking effects of the US’s monthslong energy blockade.

This is a deliberate campaign to destroy the Cuban economy, and the Cuban people are suffering. It is time to end this blockade. nytimes.com/2026/05/11/opini…

The climate crisis goes hand in hand with the affordability crisis.

As Trump continues his illegal war in Iran, dismantles our commitments to clean energy, and gives hand outs to billionaires — working families are the ones paying the price.

Video

I visited the UW Cancer Vaccine Institute, which is doing groundbreaking research aiming to develop vaccines to prevent multiple types of cancer. 

This work will save lives — and it is an example of exactly why we must protect federal funding for science and research.

I was thrilled to recognize Dr. Mary Brunkow this week for her incredible achievement of the Nobel Prize for her research with @isbsci.

This type of work relies on federal funding — the exact funding that Trump has been cutting. Our government must support research in Seattle and across the country that will save lives.

Video

This week, I toured the ICHS PACE Ron Chew Healthy Aging & Wellness Center. 

This is a beautiful space that carries on Ron Chew’s legacy, and I was thrilled to visit it during AANHPI Heritage Month.

Thank you to the incredible witnesses who gave brave and powerful testimony at my hearing on Trump’s attacks on TPS. 

Together, we will continue to stand up to Trump’s mass deportation agenda and fight for an immigration system that actually works.

Video
It was great to visit @isbsci to tour their labs, hear about their groundbreaking work, and recognize Mary Brunkow’s achievement of the Nobel Prize!

This week, I toured Lumen Field to see the transit, accessibility, and security upgrades in advance of the World Cup. 

So much intention and planning goes into an event like this. Seattle is prepared — and so excited — to welcome people across the world for these games!

Trump’s attacks on minority communities across this country are extremely isolating.

We ALL belong.

Video

The Supreme Court gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, allowing states to now systematically dilute the power of Black and Brown voters through gerrymandering.

This is discriminatory and echoes back to the racist history of this country.

We cannot give up on this fight.

Video

The Trump administration’s counterterrorism strategy is now targeting trans rights groups, meanwhile it makes no mention of right-wing extremism.

Ridiculous is an understatement. The fact is that trans people are far more likely to be the victims of crime than the perpetrators of it.
advocate.com/politics/nation…

Small businesses lost 4.5x MORE jobs in 2025 than during the pandemic in 2020.

Republicans are working for their billionaire buddies, not small business owners.

ACLU attorney Emi MacLean is fighting for TPS holders at the Supreme Court. 

Listen to her call for Congress to urgently protect TPS from this administration’s actions:

Video

The Virginia Supreme Court just overturned the new congressional maps that voters in Virginia approved.

The American people are already losing trust in the courts, and this total violation of the will of the people will only make more lose faith.

Trump’s attacks on civil rights and DEI don’t just harm minority communities — they hurt us all.

Diversity makes us all stronger.

Video

Trump’s countless actions rolling back civil rights were all part of his Project 2025 plan. 

From restricting voting rights to his anti DEI policies, we must urgently reverse these policies as soon as we get the gavels back.

Video

Even @WSJ is debunking Trump’s economic arguments for his mass deportation campaign:

-Employment among US-born men FELL in areas with more ICE arrests.
-Deporting law-abiding immigrant workers REDUCES job opportunities for American workers and is BAD for the economy. wsj.com/opinion/mass-deporta…
